item.title: Spyglass in a Bottle
item.content:encoded:
I can't believe I'm actually talking about a fictional work where someone gets their penis stuck in a water container.

I also can't believe I'm upvoting it, too.

It's works like this that draw the distinction between laughable and funny. I smirked and snorted when reading the other pieces with this theme; I had no such reaction when reading this piece, yet I found it the most funny and delightful of them all – the only one I felt deserving of my upvote.

It only takes a little creativity to write absurd. It takes good writing to ground absurd. And it takes good writing to bring the true message out of the woodworks (pun intended):

Sometimes humans did amazing and noble work for the good of mankind. Sometimes humans got their dicks stuck in water bottles.

No article could have sold the premise of Ship in a Bottle as much as this line did.

The plot of Kondraki and his misadventure will need stories like this to get the fundamental humor out of the unsophisticated narrative device. To put this into a metaphor: This is the hot water to the dick in a bottle.

item.content:encoded: I’m glad you liked it! Honestly my intent was to make an entry a little less funny than the rest; it was a sort of aftermath. Discussions about the canon a few of the contributors and I have had lead me to a place of just making the whole thing a little more grounded than us jumping the dick joke runaway train. Not to slow it down, but give it some guidance. I’m glad though you enjoyed the last paragraph! It means a lot to me and I thought it was pretty funny. :)
